crew.name: Health
crew.description: The amount of damage this crewmate can take before being killed.

crew.name: Armor
crew.description: Blocks incoming damage. Each point blocks 1 damage.

crew.name: Mana
crew.description: Magical energy used for spells and special abilities.

crew.name: Will
crew.description: Increases damage and duration of magic abilities.

crew.name: Strength
crew.description: Increases damage for melee attacks and physical abilities.

crew.name: Luck
crew.description: Increases chance to crit, decreases chance to miss, and increases damage with ranged weapons.

crew.name: Stamina
crew.description: Determines how many abilities this crewmate can perform in a turn.

crew.name: Speed
crew.description: Determines how far a crewmate can move and turn order in combat.

ship.name: Knots
ship.description: How swiftly your crew crosses the map.

ship.name: Vision
ship.description: How far you can see on the map.

ship.name: Navigating
ship.description: How much of the rough terrain penalty your crew avoids.
